label: Random Forest
why: Weighted blend of macro-F1/balanced-accuracy/accuracy ({'f1_macro': 0.5, 'balanced_accuracy': 0.25, 'accuracy': 0.25}); not accuracy alone.

label: XGBoost
why: Treats every gesture equally, so it exposes weak classes that accuracy hides.

label: XGBoost
why: Trained without the test subjects; ranked by mean minus half the std across held-out subjects (rewards consistency).

label: Gradient Boosting
why: Lowest P95 end-to-end latency among models within 0.15 macro-F1 of the best (absolute fastest: Logistic Regression at 7.98 ms, but macro-F1 only 0.194).

label: Gradient Boosting
why: Max of {'f1_macro': 0.6, 'latency': 0.25, 'size': 0.15} over accuracy, latency headroom vs the 50 ms budget and size; models over budget are excluded.

label: LightGBM
why: Smallest on-disk model among those within 0.05 macro-F1 of the best.
